newsitem.title: USA: American Power sees 20 to 25 pct rev growth.
newsitem.headline: American Power sees 20 to 25 pct rev growth.

text.p: American Power Conversion Corp said Thursday that based on first quarter results and current business outlook, it continues to believe it will generate 1997 revenue of 20 to 25 percent.
The company said it has revised its expected quarterly revenue distribution for 1997 to about 20 percent in Q1, 23 percent in Q2, 28 percent in Q3 and 29 percent in Q4.
It said it expects 1997 operating expenses will grow in line with revenues, or up to five percentage points greater than revenue growth, and sees gross margins remaining in the low 40 percent range.
Additionally, the company said its capital expenditures are estimated to grow $15 to $20 million above the $25 million in 1996 capital spending.
On Thursday American Power reported first quarter earnings of $0.22 a share, up from earnings of $0.16 a share in the 1996 first quarter.
